summary: Creator monetization platform: tips, alerts, overlays, TTS and chat integrations across Twitch, Kick, YouTube and Rumble. I own large platform programs end to end on the v2 TypeScript rewrite.
bullets: Designed and shipped the Developer API platform end to end: PowerChat became an OAuth2 authorization server with scoped consent, token lifecycle, HMAC-signed webhooks and an inbound API, so third-party apps act as pseudo-platforms feeding chat, view counts, follows, subs, currency and tips into overlays. Re-implemented Streamlabs as the first official app on the new framework.

Rebuilt the payments program as one system: a provider-agnostic charge rail with five adapters (Stripe Connect, Square, PayPal, an NMI card vault and NowPayments crypto), append-only ledgers where double-crediting is structurally impossible, Tipalti payouts, recurring Pro and viewer-subscription billing, signed webhooks per provider and an admin reconciliation surface.

Delivered 400+ commits and roughly 300k changed lines in the first five weeks across integrations, payments and Rumble connection work, backed by 240+ governed backend integration tests and 1,700+ frontend unit tests, with lint, typecheck and empty-database migration proofs in CI.
